in_urdu.name: Najaf
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Venerated, Sacred
in_urdu.long_meaning: Najaf ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Najaf’, which means ‘the venerated one’, ‘the sacred one’. This name holds significant spiritual relevance in Islamic history, as it is the name of the second-most important city in Iraq, known as the City of Peace and the Imam Ali’s shrine.

This name holds significant spiritual relevance in Islamic history, as it is the name of the second-most important city in Iraq, known as the City of Peace and the Imam Ali’s shrine.
